title: Kehti thi yehi jeene
body:
kehti thi yehi jeene se bezaar hai sughra
kehde koi akbar se ke bemaar hai sughra
<<DIVIDER>>
lene ke liye bhai ko bheja nahi ab tak
baba ko khabar di hai ke lachaar hai sughra
kehde koi akbar se ke bemaar hai sughra
kehti thi yehi jeene se...
<<DIVIDER>>
jee bhar ke abhi dekhlo tum chehra e akbar
phir bhai se milna bada dushwaar hai sughra
kehde koi akbar se ke bemaar hai sughra
kehti thi yehi jeene se...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar se kahe aaye mujhe lene ko jaldi
ay baba safar ke liye tayyar hai sughra
kehde koi akbar se ke bemaar hai sughra
kehti thi yehi jeene se...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo shehre madina jahan aksar hai musalman
tanha shahe waala ki azadar hai sughra
kehde koi akbar se ke bemaar hai sughra
kehti thi yehi jeene se...
<<DIVIDER>>
har waqt lagi rehti hai darwaze pe nazre
is karbe musalsal may giraftar hai sughra
kehde koi akbar se ke bemaar hai sughra
kehti thi yehi jeene se...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya aagayi awaaze azane ali akbar
kis ranj o musibat may giraftar hai sughra
kehde koi akbar se ke bemaar hai sughra
kehti thi yehi jeene se...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ka sar kat gaya abbas ke baazu
ab zainab-o-kulsum hai darbar hai sughra
kehde koi akbar se ke bemaar hai sughra
kehti thi yehi jeene se...
<<DIVIDER>>
acha hi hua tum na gayi saath safar may
maa behne hai aur shaam ka bazaar hai sughra
kehde koi akbar se ke bemaar hai sughra
kehti thi yehi jeene se...
<<DIVIDER>>
sughra se kahe kaun zafar margaya wo bhi
jis asghare nadan se tujhe pyar hai sughra
kehde koi akbar se ke bemaar hai sughra
kehti thi yehi jeene se...
author: Zafar
